name: Mindlin plate theory
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 考虑横向剪切变形等效应的板理论。
usage_overview: 用于轨道板、底座板及柔性道床板的结构建模与动力分析，同时计入板弯曲和横向剪切变形。以挠度与转角作为独立变量，描述板的变形响应。

complete_examples.text: Mindlin plate elements For modelling the elastoplastic plates, Mindlin plate theory (Mindlin, 1951) is applied.
The in-plane bending of the track slab, filling layer, and base plate are simulated by the Mindlin plate theory Ref. [77].

The typical ballastless track system can be modeled by finite element (FE), in which the rail is modeled by Bernoulli–Euler beam elements, and the track slab and base plate are modeled as plate elements by the Mindlin plate theory.
Using the Mindlin plate theory, the flexibility of the trackbed slab can be depicted well [35].
